## Summary

Built `ContractDetailPage` — the whole screen frame (breadcrumb header, status banner, stat strip, tab bar) plus Details/Document/Versions/Activity Log tab content and the Add Folder/Tag dialog, all wired to real `/api/v1/contracts` endpoints via a new `contractRepositoryService.js` (kept separate from uc123's existing `contractsService.js` since the DTO shapes differ for the same path). Routed at `/contracts/:contractId` in `App.jsx`, matching the navigation `ContractRepositoryListPage` already performs.

Verified with:
- `npm run lint` — 0 warnings
- `npm run test` — 85/85 passing (6 new tests covering loading, populated state, tab navigation, 403 → AccessDeniedView, and role-gated Add Folder/Tag visibility)
- `npm run build` — succeeds
- Live screenshot comparison against IMG-2/3/4 using a disposable local mock backend — Details, Versions, and Activity Log tabs match the target design closely

Flagged in `blockers` (output written to `.ui-gen/outputs/T-CONTRACT-DETAIL-PAGE-UI.json`, status `PARTIAL`):
- An ownership overlap with `T-CONTRACT-REPOSITORY-PAGE-UI`, which separately claims the same tab components
- Several design elements (Contract Type/Department fields, renewal countdown, signatures/obligations stat cards) that need DTOs or endpoints outside this task's allowlist — omitted rather than fabricated
- Clauses/Approvals/Signatures/Obligations tabs link out to other modules' screens instead of inline content, since those belong to separate tasks
